integrity: The full analytical argument and an independent supplementary checker are supplied; the results have not undergone independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Sharp support norm for positive real weights at exponent one-half only; does not recover the entire two-dimensional coefficient body, general exponents, complex weights, or higher Taylor jets. Prior unindexed mixed-coefficient equivalences cannot be excluded.
title: Exact first--second coefficient tradeoff in the Hardy space \(H^{1/2}\)
